# Parsa Niavand

> Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, and distributed backend systems. Available for freelance and full-time opportunities.

## About

Parsa Niavand is a Full-Stack Software Engineer with hands-on experience building production-grade web applications, real-time systems, and AI/ML projects. Based in Armenia (previously Iran). Works across the entire stack — from pixel-perfect frontends to scalable backend architectures.

## Core Skills

TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Prisma, Turborepo, Socket.io, tRPC, Tailwind CSS, Docker, Python, Machine Learning (PyTorch, CNNs, Autoencoders)

## Selected Professional Projects

- **Project Luna** — Enterprise platform for the power industry. Full inventory management, ordering matrix, order pipeline, and role-based dashboards. Stack: NestJS, Next.js, Turborepo, PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO. Role: Lead Fullstack Developer. https://parsany.com/projects/project-luna
- **Atrafian Chat & Social Ecosystem** — Real-time social platform with WebSocket chat, stories, radar-based discovery map, NSFW detection, payment gateway, and native mobile app (Capacitor.js). Stack: NestJS, Next.js, Socket.io, Redis, PostgreSQL. Role: Solo Fullstack Developer. https://parsany.com/projects/atrafian
- **Battery ESP/MSK E-Commerce** — Dual-brand e-commerce with warranty serial-number lookup, dual-language support, and admin panel. Stack: NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL (Turborepo monorepo). https://parsany.com/projects/esp
- **Goldenbat GPS Tracking** — Live vehicle tracking dashboard ingesting 10,000+ GPS updates/min with geofencing alerts. Stack: Next.js, tRPC, Mapbox, PostgreSQL. https://parsany.com/projects/goldenbat
- **Himeh Publishing** — Full-stack book store with author dashboards, OTP auth, payment gateway, and order management. Stack: Next.js, tRPC, PostgreSQL. https://parsany.com/projects/himeh
- **Alzahra Gold Wholesaler B2B** — B2B panel for gold wholesale buyers on a Django REST API. Lighthouse 99. Stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS. https://parsany.com/projects/alzahra
